veranderings.voor: in die volgorde waarin hulle oor meer as 1 400 jaar regeer het
veranderings.na: in die volgorde waarin hulle regeer het, oor 'n tydperk van meer as 1 400 jaar
veranderings.rede: 'regeer oor meer as 1 400 jaar' echoes 'regeer oor Egipte' in the previous sentence and can be misread; naming the time span separately is clearer.
'bekend om' is the idiomatic Afrikaans form; 'bekend vir' follows English 'known for'.
The attributive form 'verre lande' is the natural written form.

veranderings.voor: kranse waar dit gebou is, staan
veranderings.rede: 'waar dit gebou is' repeats what 'teen die kranse' already says and makes the sentence clumsy; the protected wording stays intact.

veranderings.na: jaar regeer. Dit was een van
veranderings.rede: The loose appositive after a full clause is hard for a Grade 5 reader; a short second sentence is clearer and keeps the protected wording.
'al die farao's' is the natural form for a known, bounded group.
The second noun needs its own article in Afrikaans.

veranderings.voor: wat Achenaten as god geëer het
veranderings.na: wat deur Achenaten as god geëer is
veranderings.rede: As written the relative clause can be read as the sun disk honouring Achenaten; the passive makes clear who honoured whom.

beskerm_bedenkings.rede: Protected as the video's word so the learner meets one word for one thing, but the lesson uses 'Kleopatra' throughout and gives 'Cleopatra' only as the English form; a person may want to confirm this follows the name rule rather than the video entry.
